item.description: “And yet, as I look to Jesus’s behavior in times of stress, I see that he retreated to pray and spend time alone with God, rest, or be in deep relationship with those closest to him.” Brigitte Piskura

item.title: Defiantly Feasting in the Wilderness | 2026 Pre-Conference Devotional — Q Christian Fellowship
item.description: “We are often pushed out of "certainty" and into the unknown; a scary journey that requires a prophetic imagination which proclaims boldly that the "gray area" is actually holy ground.” Rev. Dr. Jerry Maynard, The People’s Priest

item.title: Reevaluating Lent | Monday Invocation — Q Christian Fellowship
item.description: “It’s about bringing me closer to God, not the things of this world that so many contend to see as signals of strength, like money, power, or fame.” Aiden Nathaniel Diaz

item.title: Tempted to Doubt | Monday Invocation — Q Christian Fellowship
item.description: “Jesus knew exactly who he was, and everyone else could take it or leave it; their belief in his identity did not change who he was.” Kimberlee Anderson-Diaz

item.title: Unfamiliar Places | Monday Invocation — Q Christian Fellowship
item.description: “Lent is a time that compels us to think deeply about our journey with God and what it means to follow Jesus even through the harsh times.” Anthony Vernon

item.title: Our Collective Wells Need You | Monday Invocation — Q Christian Fellowship
item.description: “Lent is a season of trusting God enough to take one honest drink and daring to pour out what we have for someone else.” Dr. Matthew White

item.title: Becoming Light | Monday Invocation — Q Christian Fellowship
item.description: “When there is no shortage of darkness in the world, perhaps that is our invitation to awaken the Christ within us. Christ invites us to become light for the world. Igniting the light of love in our souls is the most powerful thing we can do to interrupt the heaviness surrounding us.” Rev. Kipp

item.title: Beauty in the Complexity | Monday Invocation — Q Christian Fellowship
item.description: “This kind of tension is one of the hardest parts of the Christian faith for me, but I think there’s a beauty in the complexity and nuance of how God presents themselves to us.” Lindsey Holt
